transcript: This is the full landing page funnel breakdown that you definitely need. The first thing you're going to do is you're going to have a top of funnel campaign with all your top of funnel ad creatives. This is your founder story, viral style, U G C, problem solution, and value based education. All of these style creatives are for the discovery phase, which you're going to direct to a P D P page, which is a custom product detail page. This allows you to break down exactly what they're getting on the first order. The social proof, viral style, U G C, features and benefits, and education and special offers. A product detail page is literally to give them as many details as possible so that way they can be fully educated whenever they're buying. Your middle of funnel and bottom of funnel are going to send them to a product page because this is where they're considering you. Looking at different options and want to be able to convert. This is going to be from a product breakdown where you're showing exactly how your product works, what the options are for bundles, variants, flavors, different sizing colors, etcetera. And then you're going to have a drawer card so that way people can easily check out. And you're going to offer them upsells and bundles because people who are already in the consideration phase. Essentially, you just want an option to be able to buy. These are the two Pages that you're primarily directing people to, you can have multiple of each to be able to get more sales.
